Name: The Timeless Pocket Watch
Author: PeacefulEnd
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/43007/43007-1772335002-124238907.png[/img][size=3]
The Timeless Pocket Watch is a mod that adds a vanilla-friendly way to pause time.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/43007/43007-1772340513-2089282215.gif[/img]
[/size]


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/43007/43007-1772335002-507226198.png[/img][size=3]
The Timeworn Pocket Watch is an artifact that can be found from artifact spots in the Mountain or the Mines.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/43007/43007-1772336686-1947356551.png[/img]

After turning in the artifact to Gunther, you will receive the Timeless Pocket Watch along with some related recipes.
[/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/43007/43007-1772335001-1292516388.png[/img][size=3]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/43007/43007-1772336990-1548593879.png[/img]
Clockwork gears can be made from Gold, Iridium and Radioactive bars. Each tier of clockwork gears increases the duration that Timeless Pocket Watch can pause time.

Golden Clockwork Gear: Pauses time for 7 seconds
Iridium Clockwork Gear: Pauses time for 28 seconds
Radioactive Clockwork Gear: Pauses time for 42 seconds

Unlocking the Timeless Pocket Watch tool will give the recipe to create additional copies from Timeworn Pocket Watch artifacts.
[/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/43007/43007-1772335001-928891632.png[/img][size=3]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/43007/43007-1772337229-1215909720.png[/img]
To activate the Timeless Pocket Watch and pause time, first you must load the tool with clockwork gears.

After crafting the clockwork gears, simply right click them onto the Timeless Pocket Watch (as you would a tackle to a fishing rod).

Once the Timeless Pocket Watch has gears, left click the pocket watch to activate it.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/43007/43007-1772337507-342875402.png[/img]

Time will remain paused until the duration is finished, but can unpaused sooner by left clicking the pocket watch again.

Right clicking the Timeless Pocket Watch will change whether it automatically consumes the next charge to keep the time paused.
[/size]

Source code is [url=https://github.com/Floogen/StardewSandbox/tree/mod-jam/pocket-watch]available here[/url].
